confidence.rationale: TabId falls back to Title when Page.Id is empty, and the same TabId is used for child-cache keys and selection preservation. The SDK permits constructing tabs/pages without an Id, so duplicate titles can route multiple tabs to the same cached child.

proposed_comments.title: Make fallback tab identities unique
proposed_comments.body:
### Make fallback tab identities unique

**Severity:** `medium`

TabViewModel.TabId currently falls back to the tab title when the hosted page has no Id, and TabbedPageViewModel then uses that value as both the child-cache key and the identity to preserve selection across ItemsChanged. If an extension exposes two tabs with the same title and no page id, activating the second tab can reuse the first tab's cached child and dynamic updates can preserve the wrong tab. Please derive a per-position fallback identity (for example by passing the tab index from BuildTabViewModels) and add a regression test covering duplicate-title tabs without page IDs.
